headline: Your Google card says you open at 8 AM. Your site says 07:00 am.
summary: JM Maintenance and Repair is a veteran owned mobile repair outfit in Ramona: farm equipment and heavy machinery, small gas engines, welding and fabrication, trash enclosures, backflow cages, and gate repair. Your Google card is up with your phone and website. The leftover is hours: when we checked, the card showed 8 AM to 5 PM, while your site lists 07:00 am to 05:00 pm Monday through Friday. Someone checking Google before 8 may think you are not open yet.

signals.note: Searching JM Maintenance and Repair Ramona on Google Maps opens your card, listed as a Farm equipment repair service.
The card shows (619) 948-1756, the same number on your site.
When we checked, the card showed 8 AM to 5 PM. Your site lists 07:00 am to 05:00 pm Monday through Friday, Saturday by appointment, Sunday closed.
signals.next: Change the card's opening time to 7 AM, and add Saturday by appointment if Google allows it.

signals.note: The card has no photos yet; Google shows an Add a photo prompt.
signals.next: Add a few shots of the truck, a repair, and a gate or cage you built.

signals.note: Your site lists every service, your hours, your phone, your email, and a quote form.
Name and phone match between your site and your Google card, and the card links to your site.
